desc: Derive marginal costs: the k-th unit of product i costs \((2k-1)P_i\).
Derive threshold count: units with marginal cost at most \(x\) are \(\left\lfloor(\lfloor x/P_i\rfloor+1)/2\right\rfloor\).
Implement threshold aggregate counts and costs using \(P_i k^2\).
Binary search an affordable marginal threshold and correctly handle equal-cost marginal units afterward.
Run and verify the provided sample tests.
